transcript.t: Oh no! I cannot log in to my school account.
Yes. I changed it last week and I did not write it down.
Do not use your birthday for a password. It is not safe.
Make a password from a sentence you can easily keep in mind, like the first letters of a song.
Good tip. And I will write a hint in my notebook, not the password itself.
Exactly. And never share it with anyone.
